clean_description: In "Rainbows End," poet Robert Gu awakens in a transformed San Diego in 2025 after a long battle with Alzheimer's. He discovers a world dominated by advanced technology, where smart contact lenses and augmented reality have reshaped daily life. As he navigates this new reality, he becomes embroiled in a conspiracy that threatens not only his family but also the future of society, relying on his granddaughter and her friend to help avert disaster.
